physics_goals.quote: The KOTO II experiment is proposed to measure the branching ratio of the decay $K_L\to\pi^0\nu\bar{\nu}$ at J-PARC.
physics_goals.value: Measure the branching ratio of K_L -> pi0 nu nubar with a single event sensitivity of 8.5e-13

summary.plain: A proposed next-generation experiment at J-PARC in Japan to measure how often a long-lived neutral kaon decays into a neutral pion and two neutrinos, a very rare process that is sensitive to new physics. It was submitted in December 2024 and received first-stage recommendation in April 2025.
summary.technical: KOTO II (J-PARC E107, proposal P107): K_L -> pi0 nu nubar with a K_L beamline at 5 degrees from the production target in a new area behind the primary beam dump of the Hadron Experimental Facility; single event sensitivity 8.5e-13, to reach a significance above 5 sigma at the Standard Model rate of 3e-11. Successor to KOTO.
